facts.fact: ARTICLE 19's UPR statement refers to Rwanda's existing Access to Information Law and says compliance with it is not independently monitored.
ARTICLE 19 says no independent oversight body has been established to monitor compliance with the Access to Information Law since the Ombudsman's ATI mandate was removed.
